status: EXACT Z2 GRADINGS OF THE STEP (O7). The mirror is the pseudoscalar: G^2 = I to 0.0e+00, [G,U32] = 7.0e-16, and it splits the module into the 16 and the 16-bar (eigenspace error 6.7e-16). Enumerating the whole Clifford grading group: 2 of the 1024 products commute with the internal step, generating a grading group of 1 independent elements; U32 has a simple spectrum, so its commutant is abelian of dimension 32 and every exact internal Z2 is a sign choice on its 32 eigenstates (2147483648 of them), of which exactly two are Clifford elements. Of the 1 non-trivial exact gradings, 1 are mirror-type (constant on the 16) and 0 are not; 0 of the non-mirror ones make a neutral colour-singlet weight odd, and 0 of those do it WITHOUT making any coloured weight odd. The V65 Wilson extension is weight-diagonal and changes nothing (2 -> 2). VERDICT: no exact Z2 grading of the implemented step (nor of its Wilson extension) makes a neutral weight odd without also making a coloured one odd: V88's asked-for parity does not exist inside the Clifford algebra of the root, so the mirror Z2 really is the only exact stability carrier, and V75's spectral no-go stands on top of a symmetry-level one.
